entities.summary: John of Wildeshausen, O.P., also called Johannes Teutonicus, was a German Dominican friar born in unknown and died in 1252, who became the fourth master general of the Dominican Order and was made bishop of Bosnia. He played a crucial role in the religious and political landscape of the medieval region. John of Wildeshausen was a key figure in the Dominican Order and was responsible for several significant events, including the establishment of new convents and the promotion of the order's influence. He also had a lasting impact on the religious and cultural heritage of Bosnia, which continues to be felt today. The legacy of John of Wildeshausen can be seen in the many institutions and communities that he helped to establish, and his contributions to the Dominican Order remain an important part of its history.
